newsitem.title: USA: Galaxy Foods sees higher fiscal yr sales.
newsitem.headline: Galaxy Foods sees higher fiscal yr sales.

text.p: Diary products maker Galaxy Foods Co said Wednesday it expected sales for its fiscal year to exceed $17 million, more than four times the amount for the prior year.
It also said it expected sales for the first quarter of the next fiscal year to reach its highest level in company history.
Galaxy's fiscal year ended March 31, while the first quarter of the next fiscal year ends June 30.
A company official said Galaxy planned to report its fiscal year earnings on June 30.
